reason: A takes on the traffic concern directly. It uses the signal the builder offered, which the study says keeps Alder and 4th at a C, and it asks for that signal as a condition of approval. That speaks to the two commissioners worried about traffic and to the neighbours who oppose the project. B brushes off the drop to a D as just a slower light. It also leaves out the signal, and it says the parking 'won't push cars onto neighborhood streets', which the brief does not support. That would push away the very people it needs to persuade.
